title: Summit's lung cancer drug sent back to square one by the FDA
hook: 你看見一顆黃色棋子走到棋盤第五格，眼看就要過關。
bridge: 棋子被打回起點後，你轉頭看見一隻大手掌把一份黃色文件擋在門外。
p: BioPharma Dive reported that the FDA this week turned down Summit Therapeutics' first request to approve its lung cancer drug, ivonescimab. The agency's letter said a modest benefit on tumor progression, plus a survival effect seen only in after-the-fact analyses, was not enough. Summit's shares fell {0}, to levels last seen more than two years ago.

Summit is not a startup, but the news matters to biotech investors. In effect, the agency {1} the idea that a small gain on one measure, backed by a survival story told afterward, could carry a drug to approval. The article gave no share price figures.

words.def: back at the very beginning, after progress has been lost
words.mn: Summit 的股價像棋子，原本走到第五格，FDA 一拒絕，棋子一路滑回標著 1 的起點格。回到第一格，就是一切重來。
words.ex: When the server crashed, we lost the backup and were back to square one.
words.exZh: 伺服器當機後備份也沒了，我們又回到原點。

words.def: to reject someone's offer, request or idea in a blunt way
words.mn: Summit 捧著黃色申請文件走向 FDA，一隻大手掌直接把文件擋住推了回去。被一掌擋回，就是 rebuff。
words.ex: The board rebuffed the buyout offer without even a meeting.
words.exZh: 董事會連會都沒開就斷然拒絕了收購報價。

quiz.q: After the failed launch, the team had to scrap everything and start ___.
quiz.why: back to square one 是回到原點重來。off the hook 是脫身、不用負責，under the weather 是身體不太舒服。

quiz.q: The mayor ___ the council's plan, calling it too expensive.
quiz.why: rebuff 是斷然拒絕。embrace 是欣然接受，rubber-stamp 是不經審查就蓋章通過。
